meta.description: Cinematic portfolio of Jesús Molano, frontend engineer. Vue, Nuxt, React and Next, under a neon sunset.

hero.name: Jesús Molano
hero.tagline: I build interfaces with a pulse. Vue, Nuxt, React, Next.
hero.scrollHint: Scroll to drive into the city
hero.sceneLabel: Sunset drive over a causeway toward a neon city skyline, palm trees on both sides
hero.speaker: Jesús
lines: Who's the guy at the wheel? Jesús. Frontend engineer. Vue and Nuxt by heart, Next when the job asks for it.
Plot twist? He used to be a soldier. Now he's a code-slinging nerd who lets the AI do all the work. Allegedly.
Favourite film? The Godfather. Favourite series? The Sopranos. Code reviews? He makes you an offer you can't refuse.
Music? The same playlist since he was sixteen. He calls it backwards compatibility.
Where are we headed? The city. Every building is one of his projects. Some of them are even finished.

teaser.heading: The city is still loading
teaser.body: Phase 2 turns each of my GitHub projects into a neon district you can fly into.
